logic.top_level: pathways (adults: any of ~20 inclusion bullets gated by a survival condition; pediatrics any of 10; S-ICD and substernal each an ALL list over the transvenous pathways)

k_of_n.quote: individuals who meet ONE of the following criteria when survival with good functional status for more than one year is anticipated
Ischemic cardiomyopathy when ANY of the following apply
Established diagnosis of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy when ANY of the following apply
Lamin A/C cardiomyopathy ... At least 2 of the following apply: LVEF < 45%; Non-sustained ventricular tachycardia; Male sex
At least ONE of the following applies: Inability to secure venous access; Immunocompromised individual; recurrent transvenous lead-related ... infections; endocarditis; younger age

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Each pathway has an 'Exclusions:' paragraph. Primary prevention: NYHA IV unless CRT-D eligible, and 'Do not meet above criteria'. Substernal has a real exclusion list (unipolar pacemaker or dual/triple chamber pacing; incessant VT/VF; reversible causes; prior or planned sternotomy; adhesion-prone history).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Device replacement: generator end-of-life criteria present, OR pocket opened for another reason AND device within 3 years of end-of-life criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Nonischemic dilated cardiomyopathy in an individual <= 70 years of age or otherwise supported by clinical scenario, when, following 90 days which would typically allow an adequate response to optimal medical therapy of Guideline Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT)*, BOTH of the following are still present
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'or otherwise supported by clinical scenario' voids the 70-year limit; 'which would typically allow' makes 90 days a typical, not a firm, duration.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Primary Prevention Inclusions: Following cardiac arrest due to ventricular fibrillation or tachycardia ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The heading 'Primary Prevention' covers items that are secondary-prevention (cardiac arrest, sustained VT); a separate 'Secondary Prevention' heading follows with one bullet. Heading cannot be trusted to select the pathway.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Syncope within the preceding 6 months or other reasonable time frame, suspected by clinical history to be arrhythmic
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'or other reasonable time frame' makes the 6-month window soft.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: LVEF > 35% with history of syncope OR evidence of extensive myocardial scar by cardiac MRI or PET scan OR Inducible sustained ventricular arrhythmias (>30 seconds of monomorphic VT or polymorphic VT) or clinically relevant ventricular fibrillation.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Capital OR and lowercase or in one bullet; 'clinically relevant' undefined.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Established diagnosis of long QT syndrome in an individual with syncope or ventricular tachycardia despite beta blocker therapy (or in whom beta blockers are contraindicated) OR Individuals with a diagnosis of LQTS who are survivors of cardiac arrest
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Two alternatives in one bullet with an unbracketed OR.
An exclusion that merely restates the inclusion list; circular for a checker (exclusion true iff inclusions false).

extraction_hazards: Strict comparison symbols are inconsistent with sibling policies: BCBSM prints < and > (LVEF <35%, >40 days) where Carelon prints <= and >= (LVEF <= 35%, >= 40 days): a conversion error would move the threshold by one unit.

The word 'Inclusions' and 'Exclusions' repeats under each of Primary Prevention, Secondary Prevention, Pediatrics, S-ICD and Substernal; 'Primary Prevention' heading is applied to arrest/VT survivors.
Footnote for GDMT is printed after the Lamin A/C bullet and before 'Device replacement', which sits outside the bullet list at a different indent.
Page numbers are single digits centered between sections; no running header.

67 pages: Rationale contains large evidence tables (study tables with columns for design, population, outcomes) that flatten into thousands of lines; guideline recommendation tables (class I / LOE) also appear in the Rationale.
Government Regulations restates NCD 20.4 including different thresholds (LVEF <= 30% post-MI; <= 35%) that are not the policy criteria.
interesting_structures: Joint BCBSM/BCN policy with full literature rationale and a policy history table.
Almost word-for-word the same adult inclusion list as Carelon's guideline (BCBSM adds survival/age softeners, substernal criteria and LQTS/CPVT survivor wording).
Substernal ICD has its own inclusion plus a real exclusion list.
NICM age limit with a clinical-scenario escape hatch.
Heart-transplant/VAD outpatient with NYHA IV as an explicit inclusion (inverse of the Florida Blue NYHA IV exclusion).
Device-replacement rule with a 'within 3 years of end-of-life' branch.
Benefit-grid for BCN products with coinsurance notes at the end.

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = clean, 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Large but regular any-of list with numeric leaves, nested ANY/BOTH/EITHER, and clear exclusions. Strain comes from the global 'survival more than one year' gate, soft escape phrases ('otherwise supported by clinical scenario', 'other reasonable time frame'), and mislabeled primary/secondary headings.
